blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has paid his final respects to former Prime Minister Cesar E.A. Virata and remembered his years of dedicated public service. Marcos and First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos visited Virata’s wake at Heritage Memorial Park in Taguig City on Wednesday before they flew to Singapore for a five-day working visit.
